messages:
alana: alert from secret-scanner: PEM found in partner bucket archive (partner-archive/2026-03-21/ingest.tar.gz) :rotating_light:

secret-scanner: match '-----BEGIN (RSA )?PRIVATE KEY-----' at gs://partner-archive/2026/03/21/ingest.tar.gz -> member path app/keys/install.pem (blob id: 7c8d9e). confidence 0.97

chen: ack. do we know which app/install id? any metadata around the blob?

alana: nearby log lines show "installation=5544 app=3141" and some CI job ids. looks like partner uploaded their deploy artifacts without redaction.

mohit: high-level plan:
1) block/uninstall the installation to prevent new tokens
2) rotate the app private key + revoke installation tokens
3) snapshot evidence and copy originals to secure evidence bucket (read-only)
4) overwrite exposed blobs with a redacted stub
5) check Vault auth methods that trust the app and rotate any bound tokens/roles
6) if wrapped ciphertexts co-occurred, schedule KMS rewrap/rotate after containment

rachel: i'll run targeted search across partner buckets for PEMs inside archives. command i'm using: `gsutil cat gs://partner-archive/** | rg "BEGIN PRIVATE KEY" -n`

alana: owners: block/install = @alana, key rotation = @chen, scrub/evidence = @rachel, vault/kms followup = @mohit, legal = @legal-bot

chen: rotation steps: generate new keypair, upload via GitHub App settings, revoke app tokens. sample: `openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -out gh_new.pem -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:4096`

mohit: Vault/KMS notes: if there are ci-kms-ciphertext markers we must determine if any unwrap endpoints could be called by that app. I'll push a temporary vault policy restricting transit/unwrap to a rotation-sa and remove broad unwrap from devops group. will open PR with 12h auto-rollback annotation.

rachel: found 2 more matches across partner-archive: blobs 7c8d9e and 2b3a4c. copying originals to gs://sec-evidence/4970012345/ and uploading redacted stub files with message: "REDACTED by security: potential private key". evidence retention 90d.

alana: legal-bot please advise on partner notification template and any regulatory considerations.

legal-bot: please include partner org name, affected blob IDs, timeline of discovery, and whether tokens were issued. recommend holding public disclosure until we confirm scope. draft prepared on hold.

chen: scanning GitHub audit logs for installation activity and token creation since 2026-03-19. flagging any API calls using app_installation=5544. will revoke tokens once new key is uploaded.

mohit: after we rotate keys and revoke tokens, schedule a controlled rewrap of any affected ciphertexts using a new KMS key version. coordinate window to prevent unwrap requests with old tokens.

rachel: partner SRE acknowledged and will delete local artifacts and send confirmation. shared read-only evidence link.

alana: timeline estimate: 0-30m block/uninstall; 30-120m rotate key + revoke tokens; 2-6h scrub + evidence; 6-24h vault/kms rewrap if needed; 24-72h audit + postmortem.

chen: adding detection rule to secret-scanner for PEM tokens inside compressed archives to catch this pattern earlier.

mohit: pushing RBAC change to vault now. PR: restrict transit/rewrap to rotation-sa, remove unwrap from devops. PR includes rollback tag.

alana: thanks team. i'll update here after uninstall and when legal approves partner notice. :white_check_mark:
